siteConfig.metaTitle: DARÉ: A Live Encounter with Sound, by Shumba Maasai
siteConfig.metaDescription: DARÉ comes to the stage: an immersive, multisensory performance by Shumba Maasai, with live performance, spatial audio, scent and immersive visuals. Bernie Grant Arts Centre, London, Saturday 7 November 2026. Doors 7pm, show 8:30pm to 10pm. Tickets on Eventbrite.
